notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a nonlegendary noncreature artifact.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary nooncreature artifact you control that is a 4/4 Construct named Mishra's Warform with haste.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mishra's Warform token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
